question: Do they experiment with offering multiple candidate corrections and voting on the model output, since this seems highly likely to outperform a one-best correction?
title: Combating Adversarial Misspellings with Robust Word Recognition
answer_rationale: The retrieved documents discuss adversarial attacks, model sensitivity, word error correction, and robustness experiments, but none mention experimenting with multiple candidate corrections or voting on model outputs. There is no evidence in the documents to support or refute the claim about voting on model outputs to outperform a one-best correction.
